physical_field_definition: electron energy +e F z; VASP EFIELD=-F/10 eV/A per official EFIELD convention
hypothesis: self-consistent gate screening retains bilayer gain over matched isolated-layer sum and upper-layer-dominated slope
falsifier: gate gain absent or not stable; upper contribution not dominant
scope: SCF for perpendicular gate only; fixed-ion spin-only NMEE from full KS finite-B response; no B-field SCF or ionic screening
gate_zero_reference: existing e000 A and lower mono; no exact upper zero needed for symmetric slopes
